Celine Dion returns to stage after six-year hiatus

Singer Celine Dion made an emotional return to the stage for her first concert in six years. She performed for an audience, sharing an emotional speech and breaking down at one point. Dion had been on hiatus due to a rare neurological disorder. She expressed her belief in her return, stating, 'I believed, I believed.'
